tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get the full details of one product by its numeric product id: name, description, price, sale price, availability, brand, rating.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories. Omit category_id (or pass 0) for the top level; pass a category id to list its subcategories.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this store's product catalog by keyword (Arabic or English). Returns matching products with their id, name, price (an object: price.price is payable now, price.sale_price present while discounted), old_price, stock quantity, rating and storefront page path (href). Sponsored placements are flagged is_sponsored.
